intent: Original material atlas, followed by a porcelain-only refinement
prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production base-color material atlas for original modular 3D bathroom props in the Nautilus Engine; painterly game art.
Create one landscape bitmap divided into an exact THREE-column by TWO-row grid, SIX equally sized rectangular material tiles, edge to edge, with no gutters, borders, lettering, labels or objects. Strict tile order: TOP LEFT warm ivory glazed porcelain with very subtle cool cream brush variation, clean and softly worn, no cracks; TOP MIDDLE muted seafoam green enamel-painted stall partition surface with fine brush wear and sparse restrained edge-free speckle; TOP RIGHT weathered warm honey-brown vertical timber planks with painted grain and modest knots; BOTTOM LEFT warm grey limestone ashlar with staggered small blocks and fine recessed joints; BOTTOM MIDDLE pale cream bathroom floor tiles with desaturated sage-green square accents and fine grout, regular repeating pattern; BOTTOM RIGHT desaturated blue-grey small slate roofing with tidy overlapping courses. Every tile is a close orthographic flat material swatch filling its entire rectangle. Soft hand-painted brushwork, readable mid-scale detail suitable for small tactical 3D game assets; coherent warm palette. Neutral diffuse color only: no cast shadows, no perspective, no specular highlights, no lighting gradients, no bevelled tile-frame effect, no ambient-occlusion border. Within each swatch make the material repeat-friendly across opposite edges. Porcelain stays mostly uniform off-white; partition paint stays mostly uniform seafoam. Timber grain runs vertically in that swatch. Never depict a toilet, bathroom, building, fixture or scene. No photorealism, no stains, no writing, no logos, no watermarks. All six equal swatches must be aligned on the exact 1/3 and 2/3 width lines and exact 1/2 height line, with no margins.

Edit only the TOP LEFT one-sixth swatch of this exact three-column, two-row game-material atlas. Remove every grout line, joint, square outline and tiled grid from that TOP LEFT swatch. Replace that swatch with continuous smooth warm ivory glazed porcelain: nearly uniform off-white with very subtle cool cream hand-painted brush variation and restrained tiny surface speckle. No distinct shapes, no tiling grid, no cracks, no shadows, no highlights. It is porcelain on a curved toilet or washbasin, not ceramic wall tiles. Preserve the exact overall 1536 × 1024 dimensions and the exact three-column, two-row aligned layout. Preserve the other FIVE swatches, their colors, texture details, and positions unchanged. No labels, text, margins or borders.
copyPolicy: Selected image copied byte-for-byte, no pixel editing.
